skill_name: Generate a short description of the rules for playing the game of chess.
workflow: Chess is a board game for two players. The aim is to checkmate the opponent's king by placing it in a position where it can't move. Each player starts with 16 pieces: 8 pawns, 2 rooks, 2 knights, 2 bishops, a queen, and a king. Pawns can only move forward, and can be used to take out enemy pieces. Rooks can move in any direction and can take out enemy pieces. Knights can make an L-shaped movement on the board, and can take out enemy pieces.
